description: Reference libraries for Project Arrhythmia modding
releaseNotes:
# 25.6.1 [Alpha]
Laying the groundwork for fun stuff...
## Changes / Fixes
- Fixed issue with some prefabs not updating properly in the editor.
- Updates to the level title system to allow for more flexibility for shorter / longer titles.
- Level intro now shows the creator of the map.
- Added new debug command "uioff" to disable the in level UI (mainly for testing purposes).
- Fixed overflow issues with multiplayer menu.
- Minor editor UI improvements.
- Laid groundwork for more realtime object types.
## Features
- You can now parent prefab objects to objects in the editor for realtime changes on spawn.
# [Alpha] -> [Default]
Expect this build to be on default soon assuming no major issues found.
